chunks: Health and free time are two unappreciated blessings.

key_terms.الْفَرَاغُ: free time, availability, or freedom from occupation

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean when it says health and free time are two unappreciated blessings?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that good health and free time are among Allah’s blessings that people often fail to value properly. Its significance lies in urging believers to recognize these favors and use them wisely before they are lost.
